name: @equin/plugin-tag-tree-picker
description: The shared tag picker: TagPickerPanel (search or create a path, a foldable tree with rolled-up counts, inline create and rename, a menu to recolour, nest out and delete, whole-row drag to reorder and nest), TagPickerPopover wiring it to a declared tree or to another backend (a TagPickerSource with the abilities it has), the TagPathChip header chip and TagMark.
